verdicts.proof: Old: reservation_edit_screen.dart:1722 shows extrasSection only if !_isActive && tab not move/swap; _missingGearSizes returns [] when _isActive (:552). v2: the same screen's build passes extras: !_isActive && !datesOrSwap ? extrasSection : null (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1571, datesOrSwap = move||swap :1553) into ResEditV2View, which renders it only if non-null (v2/res_edit_view_v2.dart:171). EditExtrasSection is the only way to change gear in edit; no other v2 entry point. Silent in both looks.

Old: reservation_edit_extras_section.dart:331 passengerSelected = !isKids && ...; :378 and :406 if (!isKids) around passenger gear and passenger boots cards; isKids from reservation_edit_screen.dart:1512 (licence 'N'). v2: same build computes passengerSelected (:331) and passes it to _v2Addons (:339); _v2Addons wraps passenger gear (:280) and passenger boots (:313) in if (!isKids); inline passenger pickers (:420) also gated by passengerSelected. Same as old (silent in both).

Size lists: boots sheet sizes computed at :96 before the v2 branch and passed to showSingleSizeSheetV2 (:99-100), which renders only those chips (booking/v2/sizes_sheet_v2.dart:113-122). v2 passenger sheet rows use gearSizesFor(..., selfService) (:149-154) rendered by EditGearSizePickerV2 (res_edit_sizes_v2.dart:69-76). Inline passenger and rider pickers (:428-486) are shared; EditGearSizePicker delegates to EditGearSizePickerV2 with the same sizes (reservation_edit_widgets.dart:235-237). Save lock for out-of-range sizes (_missingGearSizes 'gearSizeSelfServiceLimit', reservation_edit_screen.dart:618-631) feeds the same saveAction (:1536-1538) used by v2 onSave. Note: selfService ranges were added on this branch (not in 4.1.3) and apply to both looks.

Old: :349 if pickup or return is delivery -> amber banner 'deliverySizeInfo'. v2: deliveryInfo: pickupMethod=='delivery'||returnMethod=='delivery' (:337) -> EditAddonsV2 shows MgStateBanner warn with the same text as its title (v2/res_edit_extras_v2.dart:57-61), at the top of the add-ons as before.

Old closure :384-395 (remove spolujezdec + 4 passenger sizes, else add + open sheet). v2 _v2Addons :287-298 is byte-identical logic, wired as onTap of BookingExtraRowV2 (res_edit_extras_v2.dart:75-84); checked state shown via selected. Inline passenger pickers disappear because passengerSelected becomes false (:420). No other v2 path changes the passenger add-on except the v2 sheet's remove (same closure, :156-162).

Logic identical: v2 EditRiderHeaderV2 onToggle: () => onOwnGearChanged(!ownGear) (reservation_edit_extras_section.dart:446-452); rider pickers still only if !ownGear (:470); _riderSize nulls rider sizes when own gear (reservation_edit_screen.dart:629). But the picture of the toggle is misleading: v2/res_edit_sections_v2.dart:241 draws MgIcons.check when NOT ticked and MgIcons.checkCircle when ticked; core/v2/icons/mg_icon_paths.dart:26-27 confirm 'check' is a bare tick mark. Old look drew an empty box vs a ticked box (:462). In v2 an unticked 'Mám vlastní výbavu' shows a grey tick, so a picture-reading customer can believe own gear is already selected; only the colour change and the vanishing pickers tell the difference.
verdicts.fix_idea: In EditRiderHeaderV2 (res_edit_sections_v2.dart:241) draw an empty rounded box (or an empty circle) when ownGear is false and the tick/checkCircle only when true, e.g. reuse the same 20x20 bordered box used for v2 paid rows; no logic change.

verdicts.proof: Both boots rows in v2 (:300-312, :314-326) call _showBootSizeSheet with the same onPick/onRemove/isSelected as the old cards (:396-416). In v2 it calls showSingleSizeSheetV2 with sizes from :96 and onRemove only if isSelected (:99-100); chips call onPick then pop (sizes_sheet_v2.dart:118-121); footer (remove) only when onRemove != null (:124-132); closing by drag/X runs no callback, so nothing is added. Only cosmetic difference: the title drops the 'Vyber velikost –' prefix (title is just the boots name); the size chips themselves make the choice obvious.
verdicts.fix_idea: Optional: pass title: '${tr('selectSizeTitle')} – $title' (or sub: tr('selectSizeTitle')) to showSingleSizeSheetV2 at reservation_edit_extras_section.dart:100 to keep the old heading wording.

verdicts.proof: v2 branch :144-164 calls showEditPassengerSheetV2 with rows using gearSizesFor(..., selfService) and the same onPassenger*Size callbacks; each chip tap calls rows[i].$5 immediately (res_edit_sizes_v2.dart:105-108); footer 'Hotovo' = pop (:114) and 'Odebrat doplněk' runs onRemove = remove spolujezdec + helmet/jacket/pants/gloves null (:156-162, :120-123), identical to old :201-207. Only entry point is the passenger add-on tap (:296).

_addExtra('spolujezdec') runs before the sheet opens (:295-296), so closing the v2 sheet in any way leaves it ticked. Inline pickers shown while passengerSelected in both looks (:420-439, EditPassengerLabelV2 + EditGearSizePicker->V2). _missingGearSizes adds 'gearPassenger' (reservation_edit_screen.dart:589-599); saveAction is null then (:1538) and passed as onSave (:1586) -> MgCta enabled: onSave != null (v2/res_edit_view_v2.dart:190-196); ResMissingSizesV2 warn banner with title 'fillGearSizesOnDelivery' and 'Chybí: ...' list (res_edit_view_v2.dart:178; res_edit_notes_v2.dart:113-128) above the dock, matching the old amber banner (:1784-1800).

_showConfirmation loads pickup via loadMotoPickupInfo/loadBookingPickupInfo (reservation_edit_screen.dart:1271-1276) for both looks; EditConfirmPage branches to EditConfirmV2 (widgets/reservation_edit_confirm_page.dart:22-28) which shows EditPickupCardV2 when pickup != null (v2/res_edit_states_v2.dart:76). EditPickupCardV2 watches the same branchHasGateProvider(branchId) (:94) and shows MgStateBanner warn with lock icon, title 'gateNoticeTitle' and text 'gateNotice' (:119-122) - same condition as old PickupLocationLink (core/widgets/pickup_location_link.dart:150-185); the v2 gate notice has a heading, so it is at least as clear.

Both save paths call showEditFailure (reservation_edit_screen.dart:693 _saveMove move:true, :1252 _save) regardless of look; showEditFailure (widgets/reservation_edit_states.dart:112-122) uses editFailureText (:99-109, translated trailer/overlap/network reasons) and PaymentErrorSheet.show with retry = same handler. PaymentErrorSheet.show picks PaymentErrorSheetV2 when v2 with the same title/message/buttonLabel/onButton and the same PopScope (features/payment/widgets/payment_error_sheet.dart:32-58). DB triggers still refuse independently.
